classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_devout.desc: One more turning a day, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_bless.desc: The class key with the symbol in hand spends a turning: you and every friend within 10 blocks are blessed for three minutes: a little absorption, a steadier nerve, a fright lifted.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_sanctify.de: Sneak and the class key with the symbol spends a turning: the ground round you is holy for a minute. The dead won't set foot in it, and friends in it slowly heal.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_rites.desc: The class key with the symbol, looking at a body, reads the rites over it: it never rises again with the Unburied, and the village it lies in thinks better of you. A village's own priest reads the rites over its dead as well.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_healer.desc: Your healing prayers mend 30% more, and mending reaches half again as far.
Your blows carry your god's wrath: 2 more harm, 4 on the dead, and a blow on the dead may stun it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_patron.desc: Your patron adds to your blessing. The Hearthkeeper mends the blessed, the Anvil-Father mends what they hold, the Deep Mother gives them breath under water, the Green Huntsman speed, the Crowned Sun strength, the Ash Whisperer a skin fire can't touch, and the Truth lifts what afflicts them. The Lantern Warden's is the Hush: with the symbol in hand, the dead don't go after you unless you have struck them lately.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_destroy.des: The raised symbol unmakes dead three times as strong, and the great dead take a heavy blow from it, once each raising.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_shapes.desc: One more of the beasts you've studied can be worn, each rank, in the order you learned them.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_long.desc: Your shapes last twice as long.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_foxstag.des: Study a fox or a deer and you can wear it. The fox is small, quiet and quick to dig; the stag is fast on open ground, and at a run it strikes and throws aside what stands in its way.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_moon.desc: Your blows in a shape hit 25% harder, and taking a shape heals you 6.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_land.desc: You know more rites by heart (spike growth, fog, water walk, spider climb, the harrying gale), and out of shape your spells come back 30% sooner.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_pack.desc: In a shape, the wild beasts of that kind within 16 blocks follow you and go for what you fight, and you are drawn larger than they are.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_bark.desc: Sneak and the class key in a shape spends one of your shapes: for three minutes your skin is bark, 6 more armour and 2 toughness, and you are a little slower.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_elder.desc: Once a day (back with a night's sleep) you may take the shape of a treant, huge, strong and slow, or of a great wind elemental, quick and light, for half a shape's time. Pick them as you pick your other shapes.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_slots.desc: One more pact slot, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_creditor.de: Your patron's debts fall due two days later.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_bolt.desc: The class key with the seal in hand and nothing owed throws a bolt from it: weak, but it costs no slot, and it grows as you rise in the class.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_kind.desc: The class key with four of your patron's offerings in hand pays whatever debt is owed with them.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_renege.desc: Sneak and the class key while you owe swaps what the patron asks for another kind, once a debt.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_blade.desc: With the seal in your off hand, the weapon in your other is your pact weapon: its blows hit 30% harder.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_chain.desc: While the seal is in hand a familiar flies with you: what lurks near it shows, and it stings what you fight.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_tome.desc: Any scroll's spell is yours to learn, not only a Warlock's.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_arcanum.des: Once a day (back with a night's sleep), a cast made sneaking is a great one: twice as strong, no slot spent and no debt run up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.sanctified: The ground round you is holy.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.rites: You read the last rites. This one will rest.
message.jaymoskingdoms.druid.elder_spent: Your elder shape is spent until you sleep.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warlock.reneged: You haggle. Your patron will take %s instead.
